arguments.sql: SELECT orders.id, orders.order_date, (DATEDIFF('day', orders.order_date, LATEST(orders.order_date))) AS days_to_ship FROM orders WHERE orders.status = 'shipped' ORDER BY days_to_ship DESC LIMIT 1

SELECT orders.id, orders.order_date, (JULIANDAY('orders.order_date') - JULIANDAY(MAX(orders.order_date))) * 1.0 AS days_to_ship FROM orders WHERE orders.status = 'shipped' ORDER BY days_to_ship DESC LIMIT 1

SELECT orders.id, orders.order_date, (strftime('%s', orders.order_date) - strftime('%s', MAX(orders.order_date))) AS days_to_ship FROM orders WHERE orders.status = 'shipped' ORDER BY days_to_ship DESC LIMIT 1

SELECT orders.id, orders.order_date, (strftime('%s', orders.order_date) - strftime('%s', (SELECT MAX(orders.order_date) FROM orders WHERE orders.status = 'shipped'))) * 1.0 / 60 / 60 / 24 AS days_to_ship FROM orders WHERE orders.status = 'shipped' ORDER BY days_to_ship DESC LIMIT 1

arguments.subject: Re: Shipping Time
arguments.body:
Dear Sir or Madam,

Thank you for your inquiry about the shipping time. Our standard shipping time is 3 business days from the date the order is shipped.

Please note that this is an estimate and actual delivery times may vary depending on the destination and other factors. We will notify you of any significant delays.

Should you have any further questions, please do not hesitate to contact us.

Best regards,
Acme Components Support
